name: RumexWeeds: Grassland Weed Dataset for Agricultural Robotics
description: RumexWeeds is an open-access field robotics and computer vision dataset specifically collected for the autonomous detection and localized control of grassland dock weeds (Rumex obtusifolius and Rumex crispus) in organic pastures. Developed by the Technical University of Denmark (DTU) and Wageningen University & Research, the dataset comprises 5,510 high-resolution images recorded across dynamic field conditions in Denmark, featuring 15,519 bounding box annotations, 340 pixel-level semantic segmentation masks, and synchronized GNSS, IMU, and odometry telemetry.
